bio: One of Barcelona’s most original dining options, in a city full of restaurants that definitely leave their mark. Here, with chef Riccardo Radice in the kitchen and Giulia Gabriele running the dining room, the first thing that strikes you is the name, that also includes the Danish symbol “Ø” to indicate the number zero, and the suffix “Logy”, Greek in origin, in reference to a particular field of study, in this instance fish and seafood which are treated differently here (through salting, maturing, smoking etc) to create what they call “charcuterie of the sea”.
